name: merchant_id
description: Merchant ID that owns this blog post

name: storefront_oid
description: Storefront OID this blog post belongs to

name: storefront_blog_post_oid
description: Unique identifier for the blog post

name: url_part
description: URL slug for the blog post

name: author
description: Author name as displayed on the post

name: visibility
description: Visibility code: P=Public, L=Logged-in customers only, D=Draft

name: allow_comments
description: True if comments are allowed on this post

name: creation_dts
description: Date the blog post was created

name: publication_dts
description: Date the blog post was published (null if unpublished)

name: last_modified_dts
description: Date the blog post was last modified

name: excerpt
description: Short excerpt of the blog post body

name: body
description: Full body content of the blog post

name: tags
description: Tags applied to the blog post

name: attributes
description: Template-driven attributes attached to the blog post

fields.name: type
fields.description: Attribute type (string, boolean, integer, html, multiline, etc.)

name: page_assignments
description: Storefront pages this blog post is assigned to

fields.name: storefront_page_oid
fields.description: Catalog group OID (storefront page) this blog post is assigned to

name: multimedia
description: Multimedia assets attached to the blog post

fields.name: type
fields.description: Multimedia type (Image, Video, PDF, Text, Unknown)

fields.name: default
fields.description: True if this is the default multimedia for the post
